findings.description: Nicolasa Cedillo died on 22 May 1943 at Santa Lucía, Intibucá, Honduras; the civil death registration indexes her as Ma Nicolasa Cedillo, born about 1868, with her spouse Santiago Cedillo.
supporting_sources: Honduras, Registro Civil, 1841-1968 — death registration for Ma Nicolasa Cedillo, 22 May 1943, Santa Lucía, Intibucá, spouse Santiago Cedillo, born about 1868

findings.description: Nicolasa Cedillo was born about 1868, the year the 1943 death registration's stated age implies.
supporting_sources: Honduras, Registro Civil, 1841-1968 — death registration for Ma Nicolasa Cedillo, 22 May 1943, Santa Lucía, Intibucá, birth year indexed as 1868
